decisions.reason: GA4 is the current Google Analytics standard, so its tracking plugin likely meets or exceeds expectations and remains relevant for e-commerce clients.
Universal Analytics is discontinued, causing demand and results to fall far short of aspirations, triggering problemistic search and resource reallocation.
Retail system integration addresses an ongoing need for many online merchants, and with industry slack the firm can carry it while results remain satisfactory.
Shop relaunch SEO support is a relevant service that is prominently presented and likely meets performance aspirations, giving no reason to search for alternatives.
